Temple Offering Theft Cases Under Investigation, SIT Submits Reports

Police have raided the locations of accused in a Ram Mandir offering theft case, recovering a car and a motorcycle. A Special Investigation Team (SIT) has submitted a sealed progress report to the Supreme Court regarding the Ayodhya Ram Mandir offering theft. The Supreme Court is scheduled to hear the matter. Separately, the Kerala High Court has directed an SIT to expedite final reports in Sabarimala gold pilferage cases.
